activity_summary: Alse brought water that had gone cold on the second turning of the stair, and she would not heat it again. You told her to leave the letter: not to sand it, and not to carry it. Mistress Ansell, with a jug in her hands, said she would call once if you were still at work at dinner. You said once was enough. Alse had tried the mended latch and it had not stuck. The sheet stayed on the board.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the sheet on the board and did not send anyone out.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Brought the water, reported the latch, and was not sent up again.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the jug in her hands and offered one call, not a conversation.

facets.activity: Ate breakfast with Alse and Mistress Ansell

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: The stair took the warm out of it on the second turning.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Leave the sheet. It is not for sanding, and it is not for carrying.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: If you are still at it then, I will call once.
